args.title: Churn leakage
args.body: refund_amount is only non-zero after a customer churns, so it leaks the label. Drop it before training. Related: [[Verifier]]

text:
Creator mode check: the runtime inspector lists the live providers, and my custom tools (dataset_profile, dataset_suggest, brain_capture) are loaded beside the built-in ones.

Findings for churn.csv:
- 400 rows, 16% churn -> use ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, not accuracy (84% majority baseline)
- drop customer_id (row ID) and refund_amount (leaks the label)
- last_login_days is 32% missing -> add a missing-indicator
- split by signup_date (train past, test future)

I saved the leakage insight to your second brain: {{last}}
